{{Infobox Slayer |name = Moss giants |skillreq = None |combatreq = None |otherreq = None |krystilia = 100-150 |vannaka = 40-90 |id = No }} [[Moss giant]]s can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] from [[Slayer Master]]s [[Vannaka]], starting from level 40 [[combat]], and [[Krystilia]], at any combat level. [[Bryophyta]] can be slain in their stead. Moss giants are located across [[Gielinor]] and most of these locations have safespots. Moss giants have zero defence against every attack style and are 50% weak to [[elemental weakness|fire damage]]. Their most notable drops are the [[mossy key]] (required to loot [[Chest (Bryophyta's lair)|Bryophyta's chest]]) and their somewhat valuable seed drop table. The mossy key drop rate is improved to 1/75 while slaying moss giants on task. [[Bryophyta]], the moss giant boss, drops mossy keys at a much higher rate of 1/8 while on a moss giant slayer task. Moss giants slain in the [[Catacombs of Kourend]] (or the [[Giants' Den]]) may drop the [[dark totem|dark totem pieces]] at a rate of 1/440 each. Like all monsters killed on task for Krystilia, moss giants also have a chance to drop the [[slayer's enchantment]] (1/272) or a [[Larran's key]] (1/533). {|style="margin:0 auto;" |[[File:Moss giant (Kourend Woodland) safespot.png|375px|centre]] |{{Map|1517,3510|mtype=pin|caption=Location of a viable safespot for [[Moss Giant]]'s North of [[Land's End]].|width=250|height=250}} |} ==Monster Variants== {| class="wikitable sortable" !Monster !Combat level !Slayer XP !Locations !Notes |- |[[Moss giant]] |42 |60 | *[[Brimhaven Dungeon]] *[[Catacombs of Kourend]] *[[Crandor]] *[[Giants' Den]] *[[Kourend Woodland]] *[[Laguna Aurorae]] *[[Moss Giant Island]], west of [[Brimhaven]] (10 [[Agility]] required) *[[Varrock Sewers]] *West of [[Fishing Guild]] *[[Wilderness]] (by the pond reachable using a [[canoe]]) | |- |[[Moss giant]] |48 |85 | *[[Pirates' Cove]] |Requires partial completion of [[Lunar Diplomacy]]. |- |[[Moss Giant (Iorwerth Dungeon)]] |84 |120 | *[[Iorwerth Dungeon]] |Requires completion of [[Song of the Elves]].
